performance_case.causal_mechanism: Lagged public search attention may proxy deliberate information acquisition before broad market participation; requiring it to precede a separately observed volume surprise could distinguish informed demand from the excluded raw-volume confirmation family and from volume that merely reacts to returns.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This task may use only three frozen, access-proven primary studies to produce one search-attention and volume-interaction preregistration skeleton or close that family. It cannot inspect historical or forward strategy outcomes, acquire factor data, prove BTC predictability, PnL, drawdown, fees, fills, slippage, capacity, holding or inventory effects, register a hypothesis or candidate, run a strategy, open OOS, modify a forward contract, deploy, or activate Trading.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Only a later matched-capital experiment can test whether excluding high-volume entries without prior independent attention avoids adverse participation shocks and reduces maximum drawdown. This literature-only task has zero immediate drawdown effect; direction and magnitude remain MISSING_PROOF.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: A bounded three-source screen can reject reverse-causal or non-transferable attention narratives before data engineering and runner work, while the one-idea cap prevents literature mining from displacing direct evidence-ready experiments.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: If a lagged, revision-aware public search-attention measure is known before entry and its interaction with a volume surprise later survives frozen equal-capital fee, drawdown, breadth and holding-path gates, it may improve fee-adjusted total PnL by rejecting low-information DRA entries. The present task makes no performance claim.
